label: Dubstep / Deep Dubstep (Sub-Heavy, Dub-Influenced)
tempo_line: Tempo as written 140 BPM, felt half-time 70 BPM
tempo_note: Tempo is written the sourced dubstep way: 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 (drumstep: about 172-174, felt 86-87). The official melodic dubstep cards say 171 for the same kind of music. Compare by ear before trusting either.
note: Studio-authored recipe, not an official Music 3 template, untested (nothing has been rendered from it yet).

cards.mood: The track opens with distant rain, a low drone and a lone sub pulse, building tension by stripping rather than adding. The beat arrives slowly, the bass line rolls through a long, hypnotic first section, a near-silent breakdown follows…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. A few heavily processed vocal fragments, pitched down and drenched in echo, act as ghostly texture rather than lyrics.
cards.palette: A clean sine-wave sub-bass plays a short, minor-key motif with long rests, present from the first drop to the outro. A low-passed mid-bass layer adds subtle harmonics so that the line stays audible on small speakers without crowding the…

cards.mood: Smoky and introspective, the track opens with a bare beat and a lone sub note under a half-whispered verse. The hook lifts the voice into long, echoing notes while the bass swells, the middle section strips back to voice and sub, and a…
cards.vocal: Singer A (Female). The vocalist possesses a smooth, smoky alto timbre with a warm, soulful edge.
cards.palette: A mono triangle-wave sub-bass anchors the key with a slow, singing motif, entering under the first verse and leaving only in the breakdown. Warm, muted electric-piano-style chords play sparse minor voicings during the verses and the hook.
